verdict.rationale: Antigravity's own headless CLI docs say the CLI can run non-interactively to script agent tasks, plug into CI pipelines, and emit machine-readable output, which matches the story directly. The Python Agent SDK and cron-based Scheduled Tasks add further first-party automation paths. Missing for 10: detailed headless documentation (flags, output formats, exit codes) and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation

citations.quote: Run Antigravity CLI non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output.
The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Google Antigravity, programmable in Python.
Automate routine checks with Scheduled Tasks, simply define a cron schedule and the agents start and run autonomously in the background.
